title: Roth conversion cannot satisfy an RMD; RMD must come out first
notes: First-dollars-out rule: the RMD is deemed distributed first and is NOT eligible for conversion. If contributed to a Roth anyway it is treated as a REGULAR contribution, and is an excess contribution (6% IRC 4973 excise) only to the extent it exceeds the allowable regular Roth contribution. Here the retiree has no compensation, so the allowance is $0 and the entire amount is excess. DO NOT hard-code 'always fully excess' - compute the allowance.
